question.problem:
Consider the Poisson distribution $\text{Po}(7).$ Rounding to $4$ decimal digits, fill in the missing value in the corresponding table for the cumulative distribution function below.

| $\,x\,$ | $4$ | $5$ | $6$ | $7$ | $8$ | $9$ | $10$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $P(X\le x)$ | $\,0.1730\,$ | $\,0.3007\,$ | $\,0.4497\,$ | $\,0.5987\,$ | $\,0.7291\,$ | {{field-1}} | $\,0.9015\,$ |
question.worked_solution:
The cumulative distribution function of a discrete random variable $X$ is a function $F(x)$ such that

$$
F(x)=P(X\le x).
$$

The probability mass function for the Poisson distribution $\text{Po}(\lambda )$ is given by

$$
f(x)=\frac{{\lambda }^{x}{e}^{-\lambda }}{x!},\,x=0,1,2,3,…\,.
$$

In our case, $\lambda =7.$ 

Therefore, we compute the missing element of the table as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}F(9) & =P(X\le 9) \\  & =P(X\le 8)+P(X=9) \\  & =F(8)+P(X=9) \\  & =0.7291+\frac{{7}^{9}\cdot {e}^{-7}}{9!} \\  & ≈0.8305.\end{aligned}
$$
